about: Modwerk source-only euclid-accents package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/euclid-accents.

mods.title: Euclid Accents
mods.summary: The euclidean generator can accent the pattern's own trigs instead of deciding which steps play: Bool Operator gains OR*, XOR*, AND* and SUB*.
mods.description: Euclid Accents gives the euclidean page's Bool Operator (OP) eight values instead of four: OR, XOR, AND and SUB as stock, then OR*, XOR*, AND* and SUB*. In accent mode the euclidean generator no longer decides which steps play: only the grid's trigs play, and a trig on a step where the euclidean pattern has a hit plays accented. Hand-set accents stay. Turning euclid off with FUNC held bakes the accents into the pattern; without FUNC the pattern is left as it was. The accent flag is per track, kept in core-ar2's mod storage and saved with the pattern. It is an elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0002-euclid-accents, with his code unchanged apart from the storage port and OP's turn and text, which now go through core-ar2's parameter table (core_params) instead of two detours of his own.
mods.author: Iced-Cream
mods.on_unit: On an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74, as reported by the author: build P4A4 (core-ar2 0.4 with all eleven rytm2_mods ports, this module at 1.2) passed OP's eight values both ways and OP kept through a power-cycle without a project save; 1.1's accent playback and bake passed on C3A4, SXH4 and EAH4 (core-ar2 0.3). This package's own bytes, and the Modwerk base, have not been flashed from the site.
